interpretation: NOT technical replicates: duplication concentrated in 15/215 drugs, each spanning ~757 cell lines. Mechanism confirmed against the source release: these are exactly the compounds carrying two DRUG_IDs in GDSC v17.3, i.e. two independent screens over different concentration ranges. The spread bounds between-screen disagreement, not within-assay reproducibility. (An earlier version of this note attributed the duplication to the GDSC1/GDSC2 split; v17.3 predates that split, so that was wrong -- see scripts/analysis/dataset_provenance.py.)
note: sigma is an UPPER bound (duplicates may not be pure technical replicates; mean signed difference is non-zero), so max_attainable_r2 is a LOWER bound on the achievable ceiling.
